name: Ads console webhooks (confirm, budget, ad status, campaign status)

nodes.name: Load context (admin?, SMC brand, target in ad cache, active cycles, plan, cycle spend)

parameters.query:
WITH b AS (SELECT * FROM public.brands WHERE code = 'SMC' LIMIT 1),
o AS (SELECT ao.* FROM public.ad_objects ao JOIN b ON b.id = ao.brand_id WHERE ao.id = $2)
SELECT public.has_role($1::uuid, 'admin'::public.app_role) AS is_admin,
  (SELECT to_jsonb(x) FROM (SELECT id::text AS id, code, business_id, page_id, ig_user_id, ad_account_id, pixel_id, dataset_id FROM b) x) AS brand,
  (SELECT to_jsonb(x) FROM (SELECT id, level, campaign_id, adset_id, name, status, effective_status, daily_budget_zar::float8 AS daily_budget_zar,
                                   spend_cap_zar::float8 AS spend_cap_zar, last_budget_change_at FROM o) x) AS obj,
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('broker_id', c.broker_id::text, 'share', c.media_share_zar::float8, 'starts_at', c.starts_at))
              FROM public.cycles c JOIN b ON b.id = c.brand_id JOIN public.brokers br ON br.id = c.broker_id
             WHERE c.status IN ('active', 'extended') AND br.status = 'active'), '[]'::jsonb) AS shares,
  (SELECT p.plan FROM public.ads_launch_plan p JOIN b ON b.id = p.brand_id) AS plan,
  (SELECT min(c.starts_at) FROM public.cycles c JOIN b ON b.id = c.brand_id JOIN public.brokers br ON br.id = c.broker_id WHERE c.status IN ('active', 'extended') AND br.status = 'active') AS cycle_start,
  (SELECT min(COALESCE(c.extended_until, c.ends_at)) FROM public.cycles c JOIN b ON b.id = c.brand_id JOIN public.brokers br ON br.id = c.broker_id WHERE c.status IN ('active', 'extended') AND br.status = 'active') AS cycle_end,
  (SELECT min(m.date)::text FROM public.ad_metrics m JOIN o ON m.campaign_id = o.id WHERE m.spend_zar > 0) AS first_spend_date,
  COALESCE((SELECT sum(m.spend_zar)::float8 FROM public.ad_metrics m JOIN o ON m.campaign_id = o.id
             WHERE m.date >= COALESCE((SELECT min(c.starts_at) FROM public.cycles c JOIN b ON b.id = c.brand_id JOIN public.brokers br ON br.id = c.broker_id
                                        WHERE c.status IN ('active', 'extended') AND br.status = 'active'), '-infinity'::timestamptz)::date), 0) AS spend_to_date;

nodes.name: Decide (admin, SMC target, caps, mint or verify token)
Claim confirm token (single use, before the Graph call)

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO public.ads_write_log (nonce, brand_id, action, target, params, before, requested_by, confirmed_by, reason)
VALUES ($1, $2::uuid, $3, $4, $5::jsonb, $6::jsonb, $7::uuid, $8::uuid, $9)
ON CONFLICT (nonce) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id::text AS log_id;

nodes.name: Apply at Meta (system user token; ADS_DRY_RUN sends nothing)

parameters.content:
## smc-ads-console (CONSOLE-ADS-API.md section 2)
Webhooks `ads-confirm`, `ads-budget`, `ads-ad-status`, `ads-campaign-status`. The console sends its Supabase JWT; no other credential reaches the browser.

1. JWT verified (HS256) and `public.has_role(uid, admin)`; `confirmed_by` / `requested_by` are the JWT user.
2. The target must be in `ad_objects` joined to the `brands` row `SMC` (SortMyCover only). Page / account IDs come from that row.
3. Caps, +20% step, 48 h, Meta minimum are checked at preview AND at apply. Caps are per 30-day broker cycle: sum of active cycles media_share_zar / 1.15 (never typed); spend counts from the cycle start.
4. Go-live: the share is read from `cycles` here; a browser-sent share is ignored.
5. Token: HMAC `META_CONFIRM_SECRET`, bound to action + target + server params, 15 min. Single use is a unique nonce row in `public.ads_write_log` claimed BEFORE the Graph call (migration smc_17).
6. Result: `ads_write_log` (audited by smc_audit), `ad_objects` cache (budget, status, last_budget_change_at), one `ops.notifications` row (ads_audit).

**Env:** `SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET`, `META_CONFIRM_SECRET` (>= 16 chars), `META_SYSTEM_USER_TOKEN`, `META_API_VERSION` (optional), `PUBLIC_ALLOWED_ORIGINS`, `ADS_DRY_RUN=true` (validate and log, send nothing).
Needs migrations smc_16 (ads_launch_plan) and smc_17 (ads_write_log). A failed Graph call after the claim spends the token: preview again. Never autonomous: only a console tap reaches these webhooks.
